name: How do I choose between polished and honed marble for my bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between polished and honed marble for my bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right marble involves weighing finish, tile format, and bathroom traffic. Polished marble provides a glossy, reflective look ideal for vanity counters and low-splash accent walls, but it becomes slick when wet and easily shows acid etching. Honed or brushed marble features a matte, slip-resistant surface, making it safer for shower floors. For wet shower pans, smaller mosaic tiles offer added traction through frequent grout lines. Always examine full slabs or sample boxes to review color variation and natural fissures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose polished marble for vanity tops and accent walls for a bright sheen. Pick honed marble or small mosaics for shower pans and bathroom floors to improve slip resistance and hide wear.
